_about: Cost model inputs (AUD). ALL values are editable assumptions, not quotes. Outputs are manufacturing estimates only and say nothing about market demand.

electricity._assumption: Average draw including heated bed and 4 idle-heated tools; measure with a plug-in meter.

estimation._about: Slicer-free mass/time estimators. Calibrate the *_calibration factors against real prints (see scripts/cost.py --calibrate).

LOW-COST._note: Owner-operator, labour not costed, bulk filament, minimal packaging.

NORMAL._note: Labour costed at the configured rate; standard packaging.

PREMIUM._note: Premium filament, extra QC time, gift packaging.

batch._note: Recommended batch = largest candidate that fits the bed and finishes within max_batch_hours (e.g. an overnight run).
